# CompositorDiagram

**Class:** `UltraCanvasCompositorDiagram` · **Group:** [Diagrams](../Groups/Diagrams.md) · **Header:** [`UltraCanvas/include/Plugins/Diagrams/UltraCanvasCompositorDiagram.h`](../../../UltraCanvas/include/Plugins/Diagrams/UltraCanvasCompositorDiagram.h) · `#include "Plugins/Diagrams/UltraCanvasCompositorDiagram.h"`

**Inherits:** [`UltraCanvasUIElement`](UltraCanvasUIElement.md) → `Element`

## What it is for

A graph / network, or a node editor whose nodes are panels with typed sockets

## Guides and examples

The component documentation with explained, compiled C++ examples:

- [UltraCanvasCompositorDiagramExamples](../../UltraCanvas/UltraCanvasCompositorDiagramExamples.md)
- [UltraCanvasDiagramViewport](../../UltraCanvas/UltraCanvasDiagramViewport.md)
- [UltraCanvasMindMapProposal](../../UltraCanvas/UltraCanvasMindMapProposal.md)
- [UltraCanvasClassDiagramProposal](../../UltraCanvas/UltraCanvasClassDiagramProposal.md)
- [UltraCanvasRequirementDiagramProposal](../../UltraCanvas/UltraCanvasRequirementDiagramProposal.md)

## Creating it

Factory functions (the usual way - every element is held in a `std::shared_ptr`):

```cpp
std::shared_ptr<UltraCanvasCompositorDiagram> CreateCompositorDiagram( const std::string& id, int x, int y, int w, int h);
```

Constructors:

```cpp
UltraCanvasCompositorDiagram(const std::string& id, int x, int y, int width, int height);
```

The first string argument is always the element's **identifier**, never its text (see [Core concepts](../Core-Concepts.md#identifiers)).

## Callbacks

Assign a lambda to the member (or call the setter). Capture the element and its parents **raw**, never as a `shared_ptr` - see [Events and callbacks](../Events-and-Callbacks.md#ownership).

|---|---|---|

| `onNodeDoubleClick` | `std::function<void(const std::string& nodeId)> onNodeDoubleClick` | _Node double click_ |
| `onNodeDrag` | `std::function<void(const std::string& nodeId, double x, double y)> onNodeDrag` | _Node drag_ |
| `onLinkClick` | `std::function<void(const std::string& linkId)> onLinkClick` | _Link click_ |
| `onLinkCreated` | `std::function<void(const CompositorLink&)> onLinkCreated` | _Link created_ |
| `onLinkRemoved` | `std::function<void(const std::string& linkId)> onLinkRemoved` | _Link removed_ |
| `onParamChange` | `std::function<void(const std::string& nodeId, const std::string& paramId, const ParamValue& newValue)> onParamChange` | Fires whenever a parameter value is committed (SetParam* or in-place edit through a row widget). App should re-evaluate the downstream graph. |
| `onSelectionChange` | `std::function<void(const std::vector<std::string>&, const std::vector<std::string>&)> onSelectionChange` | Selection change: (nodeIds, linkIds) |

Setting onSocketRightClick suppresses the default "disconnect all on socket" behaviour; if unset, right-clicking a socket disconnects it. |
| `onNodeRightClick` | `std::function<void(const std::string& nodeId, double worldX, double worldY)> onNodeRightClick` | _Node right click_ |
| `onLinkRightClick` | `std::function<void(const std::string& linkId, double worldX, double worldY)> onLinkRightClick` | _Link right click_ |
| `onSocketRightClick` | `std::function<void(const std::string& nodeId, const std::string& socketId, bool isOutput, double worldX, double worldY)> onSocketRightClick` | _Socket right click_ |
| `onConnectionRejected` | `std::function<void(const CompositorSocketSpec& src, const CompositorSocketSpec& dst)> onConnectionRejected` | Drag-to-connect failed because sockets were incompatible. Lets the app surface a tooltip explaining why. |

## Option types in this header

### enum `SocketDataType`

Built-in socket data types. Apps can extend with Custom + a string tag. The numeric values are stable for serialization. Note: enum entries avoid the names `Bool` and `None` because X11 headers (pulled in transitively via cairo/pango) #define them as macros.

| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `Any = 0` | Wildcard - connects to anything |
| `Image = 1` | Raster image / texture |
| `Color = 2` | RGBA color |
| `Vector = 3` | 2D/3D/4D vector |
| `Scalar = 4` | Float / int |
| `Boolean = 5` |  |
| `String = 6` |  |
| `Geometry = 7` | Mesh / curve |
| `Shader = 8` | Compiled shader fragment |
| `Audio = 9` |  |
| `Data = 10` | Generic struct / record (ETL pipelines) |
| `Video = 11` | Video stream (frame sequence + optional audio track) |
| `Time = 12` | Timestamp / duration (semantically distinct from Scalar) |
| `Matrix = 13` | 3x3 / 4x4 transform (semantically distinct from Vector) |
| `Trigger = 14` | Discrete signal / exec pin (visual scripting) |
| `List = 15` | Collection / array (use customTag for element-type tagging) |
| `Path = 16` | Filesystem path (binds naturally to FileBrowser widget) |
| `Custom = 99` | Use SocketTypeInfo::customTag for sub-typing |

### enum `ParamWidgetKind`

Per-row widget hint. The diagram renders a small inline control of the chosen kind inside the node body and routes mouse events to it.

| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `NoWidget` | Just a label, no editable control |
| `Dropdown` | Combo box (choices from ParamSpec::choices) |
| `NumberInput` | Numeric text field (min/max/step from ParamSpec) |
| `Checkbox` | Boolean toggle |
| `ColorSwatch` | Click opens color picker |
| `TextInput` | Single-line text |
| `Slider` | Horizontal slider (min/max from ParamSpec) |
| `FileBrowser` | Path + browse button |

### enum `ParamValueKind`

Tag for what a ParamValue currently holds. Set by the template's ParamSpec. Note: avoid the names `None` and `NoValue` here - both are X11 #defines (None=0L, NoValue=0x0000) pulled in via cairo/pango. `Unset` is safe.

| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `Unset` |  |
| `Number` |  |
| `Boolean` |  |
| `Text` |  |
| `Color` |  |
| `Vector2` |  |
| `Vector3` |  |
| `Vector4` |  |

### struct `SocketTypeInfo`

Visual + behavioural metadata for a socket data type. The diagram owns a registry keyed by SocketDataType (and optionally customTag for Custom).

| Field | Declaration | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `type` | `SocketDataType type = SocketDataType::Any` |  |
| `customTag` | `std::string customTag` | Used only when type == Custom |
| `displayName` | `std::string displayName` | "Image", "Vector", ... |
| `color` | `Color color = Color(180, 180, 180, 255)` | Socket dot fill |
| `borderColor` | `Color borderColor = Color(60, 60, 60, 255)` | Socket dot border |
| `radius` | `double radius = 5.0f` |  |
| `dotShape` | `NodeShape dotShape = NodeShape::Circle` | Optional: shape hint (Circle is the default; some compositors use diamonds for "evaluate-on-demand" sockets etc.). Renderer decides. |

### struct `CompositorParamSpec`

Spec for one row inside a node template. Declares socket presence, label, widget kind, and value constraints. Pure metadata - no runtime state.

| Field | Declaration | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `id` | `std::string id` | Stable per-template id ("opacity", "blend_mode") |
| `label` | `std::string label` | "Opacity", "Blend mode" |
| `hasInputSocket` | `bool hasInputSocket = false` | Socket presence. Most rows have either an input socket (left) OR no socket (label-only / widget-only). Output sockets normally live in the template's outputs\[\] list, not in parameter rows. |
| `inputType` | `SocketDataType inputType = SocketDataType::Any` |  |
| `inputCustomTag` | `std::string inputCustomTag` |  |
| `widget` | `ParamWidgetKind widget = ParamWidgetKind::NoWidget` | Widget on the right side of the row. |
| `valueKind` | `ParamValueKind valueKind = ParamValueKind::Unset` |  |
| `numMin` | `double numMin = 0.0` | Constraints (interpretation depends on widget): NumberInput / Slider: numMin/numMax/numStep Dropdown: choices (vector of label strings) |
| `numMax` | `double numMax = 1.0` |  |
| `numStep` | `double numStep = 0.01` |  |
| `choices` | `std::vector<std::string> choices` |  |
| `defaultNumber` | `double defaultNumber = 0.0` | Default value, used to seed the node instance on creation. |
| `defaultBool` | `bool defaultBool = false` |  |
| `defaultText` | `std::string defaultText` |  |
| `defaultColor` | `Color defaultColor = Color(255, 255, 255, 255)` |  |
| `defaultVec` | `double defaultVec[4] = {0, 0, 0, 0}` |  |
| `defaultDropdownIndex` | `int defaultDropdownIndex = 0` |  |

### struct `CompositorSocketSpec`

One socket on a node template. Sockets live in the template's input/output lists; their layout order maps to their visual order on the side of the node.

| Field | Declaration | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `id` | `std::string id` | Stable per-template ("uv", "color_out") |
| `label` | `std::string label` | Shown next to the socket dot |
| `type` | `SocketDataType type = SocketDataType::Any` |  |
| `customTag` | `std::string customTag` | For SocketDataType::Custom |
| `maxConnections` | `int maxConnections = 0` | Multi-connection: outputs typically allow many; inputs usually one. Set to 0 for "unlimited". |
| `visibleWhenCollapsed` | `bool visibleWhenCollapsed = true` | If true, this socket is also visible while the node is collapsed. |

### struct `CompositorNodeTemplate`

A reusable template that defines how a class of nodes looks and behaves. Apps register templates once at startup (or load from JSON) and then instantiate CompositorNode instances referencing the template by id.

| Field | Declaration | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `id` | `std::string id` | "merge", "separate_color", "output" |
| `category` | `std::string category` | "Color", "Vector", "Output" - palette grouping |
| `title` | `std::string title` | Header bar "Merge", "Separate Color" |
| `iconName` | `std::string iconName` | Optional icon hint (renderer maps to glyph) |
| `headerColor` | `Color headerColor = Color(60, 100, 60, 255)` |  |
| `headerTextColor` | `Color headerTextColor = Color(255, 255, 255, 255)` |  |
| `bodyColor` | `Color bodyColor = Color(45, 45, 45, 235)` | Body panel |
| `borderColor` | `Color borderColor = Color(20, 20, 20, 255)` |  |
| `borderWidth` | `double borderWidth = 1.0f` |  |
| `cornerRadius` | `double cornerRadius = 4.0f` |  |
| `inputs` | `std::vector<CompositorSocketSpec> inputs` | Sockets, in visual order (top -&gt; bottom on their respective sides). |
| `outputs` | `std::vector<CompositorSocketSpec> outputs` |  |
| `params` | `std::vector<CompositorParamSpec> params` | Parameter rows, rendered between the socket bands. |
| `hasPreview` | `bool hasPreview = false` | Optional preview slot at the bottom of the node body (thumbnail / image preview, like in shader editors). |
| `previewHeight` | `double previewHeight = 120.0f` | 0 = auto from width |
| `customPreviewRenderer` | `PreviewRenderFn customPreviewRenderer` |  |
| `defaultWidth` | `double defaultWidth = 180.0f` | Sizing |
| `minWidth` | `double minWidth = 120.0f` |  |
| `maxWidth` | `double maxWidth = 400.0f` |  |
| `isGroup` | `bool isGroup = false` | Height is derived from row count + preview + header. Subgraph / group support. When isGroup is true: - Bounds auto-fit to enclose all direct child nodes (per groupPadding). - The renderer skips param-row and preview drawing; only header + body are drawn, with a more transparent body so children show through. - Default … |
| `groupPadding` | `double groupPadding = 16.0` | Outer padding around enclosed children |
| `groupMinWidth` | `double groupMinWidth = 200.0` | Lower bound on the auto-fit width |
| `groupMinHeight` | `double groupMinHeight = 120.0` | Lower bound on the auto-fit height |

|---|---|---|
| `id` | `std::string id` | Unique per diagram |
| `templateId` | `std::string templateId` | Refers to a registered template |
| `titleOverride` | `std::string titleOverride` | Optional per-instance title override (e.g. "Image.001" instead of template title "Image"). Empty = use template title. |
| `x` | `double x = 0.0` | Position. When parentId is empty this is world-space top-left. When parentId is non-empty this is RELATIVE to the parent's world-space top-left (matching React Flow's convention). World position is computed by walking the parent chain via GetNodeWorldPos. |
| `y` | `double y = 0.0` |  |
| `width` | `double width = 0.0` | 0 = use template defaultWidth |
| `collapsed` | `bool collapsed = false` |  |
| `isSelected` | `bool isSelected = false` |  |
| `isDragging` | `bool isDragging = false` |  |
| `zIndex` | `int zIndex = 0` |  |
| `parentId` | `std::string parentId` | Parent node id (subgraph membership). Empty = top-level (no parent). Cycles are rejected by SetNodeParent. |
| `paramValues` | `std::map<std::string, ParamValue> paramValues` | Per-row parameter values, keyed by ParamSpec::id. Missing entries fall back to the template's default for that param. |
| `previewHandle` | `std::string previewHandle` | Opaque handle to a preview image (texture id, file path, base64 thumbnail key - the app decides). Empty = no preview rendered. |
